title: Remarks on well-posedness for linear elliptic equations via divergence-free transformation
summary: This paper investigates the well-posedness of linear elliptic equations, focusing on the divergence-free transformation introduced in the author's recent work [J. Math. Anal. Appl. 548 (2025), 129425]. By comparing this approach with classical bilinear form methods, we demonstrate that while standard techniques encounter limitations in handling zero-order coefficients $c \in L^1(U)$, the divergence-free transformation successfully establishes well-posedness in this setting.
